sentences.Kollegaene til Leyla spør om hun vil bli: Leyla's colleagues ask if she wants to come for payday drinks today.
Leyla doesn't understand what payday drinks are.
sentences.De forklarer at de skal gå ut sammen ett: They explain that they are going out together after work.
sentences.Leyla har egentlig veldig lyst til å bli: Leyla actually really wants to come for payday drinks, but she doesn't drink alcohol.
sentences.Hun sier at hun ikke kan være med fordi: She says that she can't come because she has other plans, but that isn't true.
She didn't go to the Christmas party either.
sentences.Hun er redd for å bli utenfor hvis hun a: She is afraid of being left out if she never joins in, and she knows that it is important to be sociable with her colleagues.
sentences.Drikker alle alkohol når det er lønnings: Does everyone drink alcohol at payday drinks?
sentences.Er det dumt for Leyla hvis hun aldri bli: Is it unwise of Leyla if she never comes for payday drinks?
sentences.Kan kollegaene hennes gjøre noe eller si: Can her colleagues do something or say something?
sentences.Sompit sitter sammen med kollegaene sine: Sompit is sitting with her colleagues at lunch.
sentences.Kollegaene hennes diskuterer en norsk tv: Her colleagues are discussing a Norwegian TV series that they have watched on NRK, and they laugh and joke a lot.
sentences.Hun ser ikke så mye på norske kanaler, o: She doesn't watch Norwegian channels much, and she doesn't understand everything when her colleagues talk so fast.
sentences.Hvis hun sier at de må snakke saktere, f: If she says that they have to talk more slowly, she feels stupid.
sentences.Må hun se mer på norsk tv hvis hun skal: Does she have to watch more Norwegian TV if she is going to join in the conversation?
sentences.Hva kan man snakke om i pausene på jobbe: What can you talk about during breaks at work?
Hawa is at work at the hotel.
sentences.Kollegaen hennes gir henne en beskjed, o: Her colleague gives her a message, and Hawa answers yes, but she doesn't understand everything her colleague says.
sentences.Hun synes at det er vanskelig å ta imot: She finds it difficult to take messages, and sometimes Hawa has made mistakes because she doesn't understand.
sentences.Da har kollegaene blitt litt sure, men H: Then her colleagues have got a bit annoyed, but Hawa doesn't want to show that she doesn't understand.
sentences.Hvis hun viser at hun er dårlig i norsk,: If she shows that she is bad at Norwegian, maybe she won't be allowed to work there any more.
sentences.Kan du si det litt saktere?: Can you say it a bit more slowly?
sentences.Du jobber som pleieassistent, og du har: You work as a care assistant, and you have been told that a patient is going to have an operation.
sentences.Du gir pasienten frokost, og legene må u: You give the patient breakfast, and the doctors have to postpone the operation.
sentences.Du trodde at pasienten trengte mat før o: You thought that the patient needed food before the operation, but it can be dangerous to have food in your stomach during an operation.
sentences.Kan du gjenta beskjeden én gang til?: Can you repeat the message one more time?
sentences.Hvordan kan du vite hva du skal gjøre i: How can you know what to do in a situation like that?
sentences.Hva kan kollegaene dine gjøre for å unng: What can your colleagues do to avoid misunderstandings when they give messages?
sentences.Hvis du ikke forstår en beskjed på jobb,: If you don't understand a message at work, you must speak up!
sentences.Du kan be kollegaene dine om å gjenta be: You can ask your colleagues to repeat the message, talk more slowly or use other words.
sentences.Hvis jeg sier noe feil, må du rette på m: If I say something wrong, you must correct me.
That's how I get better at Norwegian.
